craft_notes: Sthāyin: fourth-state steadiness. Rows: work then ground. Read aloud: firm tread.

lines: Working the outflow-first order within, win firm ground in the fourth —
in the sky-farer's seal-entry, each to each, of own power and its lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sṛṣṭyādikramam antaḥ kurvaṃs turye sthitiṃ labhate etat khecaramudrāveśe 'nyonyaṃ svaśaktiśaktimatoḥ
